  (n : ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x = n) :
  ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
  -- Handle the case when n = 0 separately
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    -- When n = 0, the product over an empty range is 1
    simp [Finset.prod_range_zero]
  | succ n =>
    -- For n > 0, we can apply AM-GM inequality
    -- First, cast the sum to ℝ and use the fact that it equals n
    have h₁ : (∑ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast at h₀ ⊢
      <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    -- Apply AM-GM inequality: geometric mean ≤ arithmetic mean
    have h₂ : (∏ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
      -- Use the AM-GM inequality from Mathlib
      have h₃ : 0 ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h₄ : 0 ≤ ∏ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) := by positivity

      -- Since (∑ a_i)/n = 1, we get (∏ a_i)^(1/n) ≤ 1
      -- Therefore ∏ a_i ≤ 1

        (∏ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
          -- Use the generalized AM-GM inequality
          have h₅ : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) →

          -- Apply this to our specific case
          have h₆ := h₅ (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun x => (a x : ℝ)) (fun x hx => by simp [NNReal.coe_nonneg])
          -- Simplify the expression

          have h₉ : (∑ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) / (n + 1 : ℝ) = 1 := by

            field_simp

            have h₁₄ : (∏ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by

              have h₁₅ : 0 < (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) := by positivity
              have h₁₆ : 0 ≤ ∏ x in Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) := by positivity

                  rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
                  field_simp
                  ring_nf

                _ = 1 := by simp
            exact h₁₄
          exact h₁₁
        _ = 1 := by rfl
    -- Convert back to NNReal
    exact by
      norm_cast at h₂ ⊢
      <;> simp_all [Finset.prod_range_succ]
      <;> linarith
